sentences.en: Pissing off Jonny wasn't part of her plan, so she took her anger out on punching bags every evening.

sentences.en: Like a dog pissing on a tree to mark his territory?

sentences.en: Deidre tested them three times but was afraid of pissing off Gabriel by disobeying him so early in the day.

sentences.en: He had no loyalties to any of the Gods, a fact that rendered him useful to all three of them when they were in pissing contests.

sentences.en: So he nudged the scales back in the right direction, sometimes pushing evil, sometimes good, sometimes pissing off both.

sentences.en: Jessi bit her tongue, not wanting to get into a pissing match with her cousin.
